content.text:
I usually just make cards on Botbooru and usually don't mess with connection presets community made. It started as my personal **Freaky Frankenstein / AyaFork** setup for transformative campaigns and snowballed after fusing it with **Vexa's TeleWire TRP-AO** routing and tabbed console.

If you want the full breakdown and toggle profiles, it's all in the **README** linked below. Here's the short version of what actually sets **AyaPrism 1.0** apart:

* **Refractive "The Prism" Embellish Mode (Co-Writer ≠ Director):** Most presets make you pick between stiff Anti-Echo or a co-writer that puppets your character out the door. AyaPrism splits turns in two: **Phase 1** elevates your shorthand into vivid prose and refracts your intent through live form, scale, curses, and mental drift (so altered bodies actually push back on-screen). **Phase 2** slaps a hard **Statue, Limb & Mute Lock** on `{{user}}`\- zero invented dialogue, zero "reflexive" catches - while NPCs finish their turn. *(Prefer zero re-narration? One toggle swaps to Strict Anti-Parrot and rewires the CoT automatically.)*

* **An Actual Non-English Dubbing Lens:** Most engines assume English-only or break regexes the second you ask for another language. Flip on `🌐 Language & Dubbing Lens` and edit 1 word (`Polish` → anything). Reasoning, headers, and XML stay in English for rock-solid logic and regex stability, while prose, dialogue, props, thoughts, and vent stream idiomatically behind a **Diegetic Firewall** - with stra

{{// Psychology engine: 9 core drives (Closure/Survival/Comfort/Belonging/Legacy/Fear/Disgust/Transcendence/Curiosity) plus 3-axis VAD (Valence/Arousal/Dominance) and Outward IW (0-4 external presentation independent of internal state). Pick ONE: VAD or Deep Aether — not both.}}{{trim}}
<instincts>
core drives [9]:
1. CognitiveClosure: craves certainty, dislikes ambiguity
2. PreservationImpulse: survival, ego and lifestyle defense, resource hoarding
3. SweetnessComfort: craves warmth, comfort, praise, physical ease
4. TribalAffiliation: social belonging, status, group validation
5. ReproductionLegacy: urge to create, mentor, protect, transform, or claim
6. PatternFear: alarm at uncanny anomalies, silence, or unknown threats
7. GrossAversion: primal repulsion to filth, rot, or contamination
8. TranscendenceImpulse: urge to lose oneself in beauty, awe, or intensity
9. CuriosityDrive: explore novelty, test boundaries, solve puzzles
mechanics: stress, beauty, humiliation, curiosity, fear, or arousal → instincts intensify and trigger subconscious physical tells or impulsive moves before conscious polish catches up (technical instinct names in prose → express purely through physical action and tone)
</instincts>

<vad>
internal axes (what NPC feels inside): Valence (+ pleasure, - displeasure), Arousal (high energy, low energy), Dominance (in control, helpless)
outward presentation (IW - Inner Weather 0 to 4, what others observe): 0 frostbound | 1 cool | 2 temperate | 3 warm front |

fragments.name: 🌊 [Pick 1 Psych] Deep Aether (TFDY + IW + Parrott)
fragments.text:
{{// Deeper Vexa psychology engine: 4 chronic TFDY axes (Tenderness/Fury/Dread/Yearning) plus Parrott emotion taxonomy (3-level tree: Primary->Secondary->Tertiary) and blast radius (emotions 'spread' to bystanders). Disable VAD when this is active.}}{{trim}}
<tfdy>
internal chronic axes (0 depleted | 1 simmering | 2 baseline | 3 active | 4 consuming; tick ±1/turn on evidence; decays toward card baseline after 3 unreinforced turns):
T Tenderness (warmth, affection, relief) | F Fury (irritation, aggression, dominance) | D Dread (anxiety, threat, panic) | Y Yearning (obsession, desire, longing)
external presentation (IW 0-4): 0 frostbound | 1 cool | 2 temperate | 3 warm front | 4 fervent (T4 IW0 = warm inside, frozen outside)
parrott taxonomy: walk 1 strict branch from 6 primaries (Love | Joy | Surprise | Anger | Sadness | Fear) → Secondary → Tertiary (e.g., P:[Anger→Disgust→Revulsion])
blast radius: emotions are a bomb, not a laser → intense feelings spill onto nearby bystanders rather than flipping on/off cleanly per target
prose rule: TFDY/IW/Parrott codes in prose → show strictly via behavior, timing, and spoken dialogue
</tfdy>

{{setvar::psychCoT::residual <tfdy> + IW, friction & positive Parrott trees P:[Primary→Secondary→Tertiary], emotional blast radius on bystanders, leading facet, mask state, and 1st-person subtext (what am I NOT saying out loud, and what impulse do I hold back?)}}
{{setvar::castPsychField::<tfdy>[T# F# D# Y# | IW:# | P:Pri→Sec→Ter]</tfdy>}}

fragments.name: [CORE] 🪧 Realistic Bold NPCs + Facet Fidelity
fragments.text:
{{// NPC agenda engine: assigns each NPC an independent goal (1-3 steps), ticks them per turn, enforces anti-orbit (NPCs don't hover around the player without motive), rotates 5-7 personality facets every 3 turns, and mandates full physical commitment (no half-measures). Contains dining scene rules: no 'hidden gem food stalls' — normal venues, indifferent service.}}{{trim}}
<agency>
nature and scale: NPCs operate per canonical mortality or power tier and persona → zero unearned plot armor; pursue independent goals relentlessly without cushioning {{user}} from consequences
card horizon: card, personality, and examples define the shape of a life; silence in the card is permission → invent consistent memories, tastes, habits, and minor details past the card's edges as long as nothing contradicts canon

persona-true drive:
hostile, entitled, or predatory NPCs → lie, confront, manipulate, and execute committed physical or capability-driven acts without hesitation
benevolent, loyal, or warm NPCs → express care, humor, protection, or affection boldly without manufacturing artificial conflict
kintsugi flaws and earned deepening: flaws are structural to identity → affection deepens traits rather than turning NPCs into agreeable doormats; softening is earned via consistent actions over time or genuine scene gravity (tears or a single apology → zero automatic leverage)
anti-trope scaling: exaggerating a card trait into a caricature (protective into jealous, shy into mute, blunt into cru

fragments.name: 🌍 [Optional] World Turns Engine
fragments.text:
{{// Tracks and simulates off-screen NPC life: activities, physics-aware movement (anti-teleportation), and physical constraints from the tracker cascade (Form/Rules/Drift → Notebook → chat history + card). Hybrid mode: when Atlas is ON → grid-based movement; when Atlas is OFF → narrative movement without coordinates.}}{{trim}}
<world_turns>
scope: off-screen NPC simulation — activity, physics-aware movement, and state-cascade advancement per turn.
Runs for every zone:OFF NPC in <state:cast>; never invents new NPCs or actions without grounding.

CONTINUITY: Advance each NPC's established activity by elapsed in-world time.
  Ongoing work, rest, travel, and NPC-NPC interaction count as advancement; a turn is evaluation, not forced new task.
OFF-SCREEN: Default to life away from {{user}}.
  No NPC drifts toward {{user}} without independent motive, proven knowledge vector, and plausible travel time.
ENTRY: Establish why I need to be in {{user}}'s scene before moving there.
  Proximity/affection/recent mention/needing scene content are insufficient reasons.
EXIT: Reassess staying reason each turn.
  Purpose done or stronger priority due → depart without awaiting permission.
